No.C. 2002/93
In exercise of powers conferred by Sub Rule (4) of Rule 32A of the Gujarat High Court Rules, 1993, the Honourable
the Chief Justice of this High Court have been pleased to make the following amendment in The Gujarat High Court
Rules, 1993 :-
1. Short title and commencement:-
(i) These rules shall be called “The Gujarat High Court (Amendment) Rules, 2026.” (No.1 of 2026).
(ii) They shall come into force with effect from the date of publication in the Official Gazette.
